[[Hunting Trip]] (+18-24hr) |leads to = |related = |related2 = |reqkappa =No }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Dialogue== {{quote|Greetings, mate. Tell you what, I've got special import channels - they can bring things even from Finland! My friend there has set up a shipment of some real deadly toys, not just shitty-ass Toz or Gornostay. Thing is, you can't just sell those to any random bum off the street, speaking from experience, mate. Dumb twats with hands out their asses will bring down the credibility of even the toughest merchandise. That's why I've come up with a little innocent trick. I want to start a rumor that there's a real bringer of death in Tarkov, you feel me? He shoots precisely and leaves heaps of corpses on his path. No one can even spot him in time, because the guy's a specialist, he sticks to the shadows and uses a bolty with a night sight. And then it turns out that this guy is using my guns! It's gonna make everybody think that I'm the guy who stocks up on the realest pro stuff. So I figured you'd be the perfect man for this little stunt. Make people afraid to even take a piss at night, and I'll arrange some of my hot new products for you. The first batch is free!}} ==Requirements== * Unlocks 18-24 hours after completion of [[Silent Caliber]] and [[Hunting Trip]] ==Objectives== * Eliminate 20 PMC operatives from over 40 meters away while using a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] with [[Weapon_mods#Sights_.28Functional_Mods.29|night or thermal scope]] ==Rewards== * +21,000 [[EXP]] * [[Skier]] Rep '''+0.03''' * 1× [[Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle]] * 2× [[Sako TRG M10 .338 LM 8-round magazine]] * 1× [[.338 Lapua Magnum FMJ ammo pack (20 pcs)]] * Unlocks purchase of [[Sako TRG M10 .338 LM bolt-action sniper rifle]] at [[Skier]] LL4 {{quote|I shit you not, even my partners heard about it! You're gonna become a real legend with this Finnish lady by your side.}} ==Guide== In this quest you have to kill 20 PMCs from over 40 meters away while using a [[Weapons#Bolt-action rifles|bolt-action rifle]] with a [[Weapon_mods#Sights_.28Functional_Mods.29|night or thermal vision sight]]. To have the kills count for this quest, the sight just needs to be installed on the gun, and not necessarily be actively used. This means you can use a sight that supports backup sights, like the [[Armasight Vulcan MG 3.5x Bravo night vision scope]], and use any compact reflex sight of your choice on top. {{Navbox quests}} [[Category:Quests]] [[fr:Connexions du Nord]] [[ru:Связи на севере]]
